correctness.rationale: Exact H is conserved; its proper even potential gives one regular closed energy oval for each A. Time-preserving z-coordinate reduces dynamics to a conservative oscillator; comparison \(B(x)>x/(1+\alpha x^4)\) proves restoring slope \(h(z)/z\) strictly rises whenever \(\alpha+\beta>0\), so the full period integral is strictly decreasing. The fifth-order force jet gives the small-A coefficient. The alpha=0 axis follows dominated convergence. For alpha>0 an exact boundary-layer substitution has a uniform e^{-u/4}/sqrt(min(u,1)) majorant and evaluates to pi/2, proving the claimed high-A limit, not merely numerical interpolation. Standalone checker checks all key symbolic identities and sample quadratures. The alpha=beta=0 harmonic limit and alpha=0 boundary separately handled.
